# crosswork_local_congestion_mitigation_interface_thresholds (Resource)

This resource can manage the per-interface utilization thresholds of one LCM domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_local_congestion_mitigation_interface_thresholds" "example" {
  domain_id = "32"
  interface_thresholds = [
    {
      node                  = "build-router-1"
      interface             = "GigabitEthernet0/0/0/14"
      utilization_threshold = 75
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) LCM domain identifier

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `interface_thresholds` (Attributes Set) The interfaces with their own utilization threshold; an empty list removes them all. Only interfaces of the IGP links of the domain are accepted, by the full interface name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interface_thresholds))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--interface_thresholds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interface_thresholds`

Required:

- `interface` (String) Full name of the interface, of an IGP link of the domain
- `node` (String) Host name of the device that has the interface
- `utilization_threshold` (Number) Utilization percentage at which the interface is considered congested; not below the hold margin of the domain
  - Range: `0`-`100`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_local_congestion_mitigation_interface_thresholds.example "<domain_id>"
```
